## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与最终行为

Describe the concrete trigger, changed behavior and affected permission/data boundary.

描述具体触发条件、变化后的行为及受影响的权限或数据边界。

## Validation / 验证

List commands, environments, observed results and relevant checks not run. Identify fixtures, physical media and real-provider tests accurately. For a release change, include artifact version and hash.

列出命令、环境、实际结果及未执行的相关检查。准确区分测试夹具、实体媒体和真实服务测试；发布变更应包含安装包版本与哈希。

## Documentation and release impact / 文档与发布影响

Describe API, permission or data-version changes and the corresponding bilingual guide updates. Use repository-relative paths. Keep credentials, room state, personal files and generated runtime caches out of the change.

说明 API、权限或数据版本变化及相应双语指南更新。使用相对于仓库根目录的路径；不要提交凭据、房间状态、个人文件或生成的运行时缓存。
